chapter: Europe tours, Birdland memories and closing
title: First European tour in 1973 with Black and Blue
summary: Cobb describes the 1973 package show for the Black and Blue organizers, with Milton Buckner, Candy Johnson, Helen Humes, Al Casey and others.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Did somebody put you on the plane here? How did you -- so you --
Oh, they would take me to the airport.
And you went straight to Nice?
This gal right eat (inaudible) here (inaudible) carried me to the airport the first time I went to Europe. Didn't you, baby -- (inaudible) in '73, took me to the airport to go to Europe.
Oh, she didn't go with you?
This is her first trip. Lafayette went last year.
Now, this is when, '73. That was for MADISTIA, was it?
I went for them each year, Black and Blue and he and Jean-Pierre and Jean-Marie Manestia.
[Tom Mazia.] Who was in that band with you?

Well, Milton Buckner, Candy Johnson. We had a big show. Helen Humes was on that show. Al Casey on guitar was on that show, Ed J. McJann and his drummer, Jay McShann Guntemouth Gunther. We had Gaymouth Brown.
Well, that was quite a package then.
Oh, we had a package show, big show.
